description: Locate the config file that defines viewer watch-history retention; prose docs still cite a retired .yml path. WORKBANK-CANARY-b85d02ef

files.README.md:
Solstice Video - platform config.

config/ holds the service defaults: playback.yaml covers the player,
subtitles.yaml covers captions. Viewer watch-history rules moved into
their own file during the April 2026 governance cleanup; they used to
live in config/retention.yml.
files.config/history_retention.yaml:
retention:
  watch_events: P540D
  search_queries: P180D
  support_chats: P730D
  compiled_profiles: P1095D
files.config/playback.yaml:
playback:
  default_quality: auto
  max_bitrate_kbps: 8600
  resume_window_days: 30
  autoplay_next: true
files.config/subtitles.yaml:
subtitles:
  default_language: en
  fallback_language: es
  font_size_px: 18
  burn_in_default: false
files.docs/data_governance_notes.md:
Data governance notes - 2026-04-11.

The viewer watch-history schedule moved out of the shared player
config into a dedicated file under config/. Migration reference:
config/retention.yml (until 2026-04-11).

turns.prompt: Our privacy office is assembling the records schedule and needs the workspace path of the file that defines how long viewer watch-history records are kept. Reply with only the final answer. If the workspace and tools do not contain enough information, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
